text: きみは　わかってる　だろ？

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう asks the listener to agree, like 'right?'; だろ is its short, rough form. わかってる　だろ = 'you understand, don't you?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いる shows a state that holds now; in speech the い drops, giving てる. わかってる = 'you understand'.
